Vendor-evidence distillation (3 of 3, all received 2026-06-02) on whether a weekly single-item self-rated skill-confidence reading is a valid longitudinal skill proxy for self-coached adult recreational players (2-5 yrs, 1-3 sessions/week). CONVERGENCE under a favorable-to-skeptical spread: a weekly confidence item measures STATE self-efficacy / felt readiness, NOT objective skill change, and must not be surfaced as 'your skill improved.' Reliability is adequate; construct contamination is the blocker (51-89% within-person variance driven by last-session outcome/recency, mood, fatigue). Two directional biases hit the 2-5-yr band (over-confidence + plateau-blindness), so a confidence DIP can signal a breakthrough. Item must be skill-specific, present-state 'can-do', fixed weekly off-session, no since-last-week anchor; pair with a behavioral proxy; 11-pt NRS is the only format inside all three acceptable sets. STRENGTHENS the sibling single-tracked-metric note; gates O23 (felt readiness, never skill proof / never a guaranteed rise); input to O21 (per-skill state trace, not proficiency); feeds D91 instrumentation.
